name: slack-mcp
description: Adds korotovsky/slack-mcp-server for reading channels, message history, threads, users, and user groups with a Slack bot token. A bot sees only the channels it was invited to and cannot search. SLACK_MCP_ENABLED_TOOLS lists only read tools, so posting, reactions, joining or leaving channels, and user-group or saved-item changes stay off. From 2026.10.25 it replaces the archived reference Slack server: put the xoxb- bot token in SLACK_MCP_XOXB_TOKEN; SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_TEAM_ID and SLACK_CHANNEL_IDS are no longer read.
